1.be+doing：构成进行时态,有现在和过去两种进行时态.
The girls are reading and copying the new words now.
2.be+done：构成被动语态(主语是动作的承受者,done必须是及物动词).
Tea is grown in my hometown.(一般现在时的被动语态)
This building was built three years ago.(一般过去时的被动语态)
Our classroom has been cleaned and tidied already.(现在完成时的被动语态)
How could this kind of cakes be made in your home?(含情态动词的被动语态)
That is a day never to be forgotten.(动词不定式的被动语态)
3.be+going to do,表示"打算或将要做某事",be有现在和过去两种形式.如：We are going to plant trees in the park.
4.be+to do,表示"按计划安排将要做某事".如：The new shop is not to be opened till next Monday.
功能三,there be
there be句式为：there be+主语部分＋状语部分,表示"某处存在某物",be常用现在时,过去时和将来时等.如：
There are about 80 pyramids in Egypt.
功能四,实义be
可以将be视为实义动词,因为它具有实际的词义,如"成为;做;发生;举行;逗留;到达"等.如：His daughter wants to be a doctor for animals in her twenties.

巴洛克（baroque）是十七世纪欧洲的艺术风格，初发源于17世纪教皇统治的罗马。它的兴起与罗马天主教反宗教改革运动及西欧国家君权的加强有密切关系，或许是教会与宫廷需要表现动感与力量的艺术去表达对上帝与君王的尊敬与权威，传达对新教分裂天主教及封建割据阻碍国家统一的不满；总之，它是为教权与君权的强化服务的。与文艺复兴时期所推崇的古典主义不同，巴洛克风格抛弃了单纯、和谐、稳重的古典风范，追求一种繁复夸饰、气势宏大、奔放、富于动感的艺术境界。这种风格集中体现在天主教教堂上，并影响到了家具和室内设计。

mnemonic:
[词源]
bikini：两段式女游泳衣

1947年 bikini 这种两段式女游泳衣首次在法国假日游憩胜地里维埃拉( Riviera )海滨出现时，曾经在社会上引起了极大的轰动。最初法国人将它取名 le minimum ，随后又有人改称之为 bikini 。 bikini 一词始见于《世界报图文版》( Le.Monde Illustre )当年8月号第1期上。翌年，英语便将该词直接借用了过来。 bikini 得名于西太平洋马绍尔群岛( Marshall Islands ) 一个珊瑚岛岛名。1946年美国在该岛进行了一系列原子弹试验。取名者之所以将这种两段式女游泳衣同该岛岛名加以联系很可能是因为认为，身着该式游泳衣的身段苗条的青年女子可能引起异性的感情冲动力足以与 Bikini 岛上的原子爆炸力相比拟。在这个意义上 bikini 可以说是联想的产物。 1964年又出现了上裸游泳衣，人们仿 bikini 造出了 monokini 一词来表示，随后产生的 trikini （三点式女泳装）， nokini （“裸体”的代称）等司都是按类比法构成的。显然，名称的创造者有意无意地将 bikini 错误地分解为 bi- 和 -kini 两部分，仿佛 bi- 就是意为“二”的前缀。

mnemonic:
[词源]
bootleg（走私）：美国禁酒期间私酒贩子用靴筒藏匿私酒
美国最初的移民以清教徒为主，他们反对饮酒。1920年，美国通过宪法第18号修正案——禁酒法案，任何人不得制造、售卖和运输酒精含量超过0.5%的饮料。人们可以在家里饮用以前买来的酒，但不得在公开场合或聚众饮酒。
禁酒令根本无法消除人类对饮酒的欲望和需求，带来了巨大的社会问题。合法市场被取缔后，地下贩卖私酒的黑市蓬勃发展，黑手党也通过控制贩卖私酒的黑市而谋取暴利从而发展壮大。私酒贩子想尽各种办法来藏匿私酒，其中最常用的方法就是把私酒藏在高筒靴的靴筒里，从而诞生了bootleg v.走私

[词源]
bromide（陈词滥调）：用作镇静剂的溴化物
在西方，从19世纪到20世纪早期，溴化物（bromide）尤其是是溴化钾（potassium bromide）常被用作镇静剂，可以作为非处方药直接在药店购买。所以我们常常可以在当时的文学作品中看到妇女在情绪激动时掏出一小包溴化钾放到鼻子前嗅闻的场景。直到1975年，由于可能引发慢性中毒，政府才下令禁止随意销售溴化物。
当人们在劝慰情绪激动的人时，往往都会说一些被人反复说过的话，如“别着急，事情总会好起来的”、“做人呢最重要的是要开心”。这种用来劝慰人的陈词滥调就被比作bromide。

英语单词braille（盲文）源自全球通用盲文的发明者路易•布莱叶（Louis Braille）的姓氏。布莱叶三岁时左眼意外受伤失明，随后右眼也因受感染而失明。十岁时，天资聪颖的布莱叶获得一笔奖学金，得以进入巴黎盲人学校学习。该校使用的教材是一种凸出字母，由铜丝在纸张上压制而成。盲人学生在学校学习如何阅读这种盲文，但无法进行书写。1821年，一名退伍海军军官访问了这所学校，向学生们介绍了自己发明的夜间书写文字代码系统。该代码系统使用12个凸点的不同排列组合来表达意思，可以帮助士兵在夜间无需发音即可进行传递信息。受此启发，布莱叶在15岁发明了自己的凸点代码。

布朗尼（Chocolate Brownie），19世纪末发源于美国，后成为美国家庭餐桌上的常客。布朗尼蛋糕的质地介于蛋糕与饼干之间。布朗尼可以有多种样式。布朗尼的原料通常包括坚果、霜状白糖、生奶油、巧克力等。
在美国，布朗尼是常见的午餐，通常直接用手抓取食用，并配以咖啡、牛奶。制作布朗尼可以在表面覆盖冰淇淋、生奶油、杏仁糖或撒上粉状白糖等等。
布朗尼蛋糕属于重油蛋糕的一种，但它和一般重油蛋糕的区别在于通经典布朗尼较薄且较结实，不像普通蛋糕那样松松的, 而且一定是巧克力口味，上面还会放杏仁或核桃作装饰及调味，通常比较甜。
布朗尼据说是一个胖胖的黑人老太太围着围裙，在厨房烘培着松软可口的巧克力蛋糕，结果却忘了将黄油打发，而做出的失败作品。这块原本要丢掉的蛋糕，老太太一尝，居然意外的美味，布朗尼蛋糕这个“可爱的错误”就这么成为美国家庭中最代表性的蛋糕了。

[辨析]
一、意思不同
1、blow off：炸掉，吹掉，吹走，放气。
2、blow out：吹灭，熄灭。
二、用法不同
1、blow off：blow本意为“吹，刮，吹动”，引申可指“吹响”，也可作“爆炸”解。在美国俚语中还可表示“匆匆离开”“挥霍金钱”“吸毒”等意思。
2、blow out：blow作及物动词时，一般接名词或代词作宾语，也可接同源宾语。作“带来”解时可接双宾语，作“灌输”解时，可接复合宾语，指自然界的风云变化时，可接形容词或名词充当表语。
三、侧重点不同
1、blow off：是借助外力吹灭东西。
2、blow out：一般用被动时态，受力者充当主语。

accuse accusation accusatory accuser

translation: phrase. 贪得的；渴望获得的；有占有欲的
exampleEn: He is acquisitive and always wants more things.
exampleZh: 他很贪得无厌，总是想要更多东西。
englishDefinition: Wanting to have and keep a lot of possessions, especially in a way that seems selfish or greedy.
mnemonic: 啊(a)渴(quis)望的(itive)!想象一个贪婪的人，看到什么都想要，说:“啊渴望的!”这就是他的贪婪本性!

translation: phrase. 害怕做某事；不敢做某事
exampleEn: He is afraid to speak in class.
exampleZh: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
englishDefinition: To feel fear or hesitation about doing something.

translation: phrase. 害怕做某事；不敢做某事
exampleZh: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
englishDefinition: If you are afraid to do something, you are frightened to do it or unwilling to do it because you think it might be dangerous or harmful.
mnemonic: 怕(afraid)做(to do)!想象一个人站在跳板前，心里想着：“怕做这个跳水的动作！”这就是他“害怕做某事”的心情！

translation: phrase. 对……感到惊讶；对……感到惊奇
exampleZh: 我惊讶于她跑得有多快。
englishDefinition: To be filled with wonder or astonishment.
mnemonic: 被(be)惊讶(amazed)于(at)!想象一下，当你看到令人惊叹的景象时，你可能会说:“被惊讶于!”这就是你对某事物感到惊讶的表达方式!

translation: 短语. 是能力的指标；表示某人能力的标志
exampleEn: Her high score on the test is an indicator of her ability to learn quickly.
exampleZh: 她在测试中取得的高分是她学习能力强的指标。
englishDefinition: To serve as a sign or proof of someone's skill or capability.

translation: phrase. 生…的气；对…感到气愤
exampleEn: My mom is angry with me for coming home late.
exampleZh: 我妈妈因为我回家晚而生我的气。
englishDefinition: To feel or show anger towards someone because of something they have done.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
be angry with sb. 对某人生气
be angry at 对某人或某事生气
be angry about 为某事生气
get angry 生气；发脾气
be mad at 对…生气
get mad 生气

translation: 短语. 有争议的；成为争论焦点的
exampleEn: What he said is at issue.
exampleZh: 他说的话是争议的焦点。
englishDefinition: To be the subject of debate or dispute.
mnemonic: 被(be)在(at)问题(issue)上，想象一个问题正在被讨论，这就是“有争议的”状态。

translation: phrase. 被……吸引；对……产生兴趣
exampleEn: He is attracted by the bright colors of the painting.
exampleZh: 他被这幅画的鲜艳色彩吸引。
englishDefinition: To be drawn to or interested in someone or something.

translation: phrase. 可归因于；应归于（某种原因或来源）
exampleZh: 这个错误归因于粗心。
englishDefinition: If something is attributable to a particular cause, it is likely that it was caused by that thing.
mnemonic: 被(be)啊(a)特(tr)里(ib)布(ut)啊(a)波(ble)图(to)!想象一个侦探在犯罪现场，指着线索说:“被啊特里布啊波图!”这就是他发现“可归因于”的证据!

translation: phrase. v. 离开；不在某地；远离
exampleEn: He is away from school today.
exampleZh: 他今天不在学校。
englishDefinition: To be in a place that is not near or close to a particular location or person.
mnemonic: 别(be)呀(away)从(from)！想象你在一个地方，突然决定'别呀，从这里离开！'这就是'be away from'的情景。

translation: 短语动词. 恢复健康；恢复经济独立；重新站稳脚跟；恢复正常状态
exampleEn: He broke his leg, but he is back on his feet now.
exampleZh: 他摔断了腿，但现在已康复了。
englishDefinition: To recover from an illness or setback and return to a normal state of health or operation.
mnemonic: 想象一个人从病床上站起来，拍拍身上的灰尘，说：“我又站起来了！”这就是“be back on one's feet”的形象。

exampleEn: He was banned from entering the club after causing a disturbance.
exampleZh: v. 他因引起骚乱而被禁止进入俱乐部。
englishDefinition: To be officially prohibited from doing something.
mnemonic: 被(be)绊(ban)倒的(ed)！想象一个人因为被禁止做某事而感到绊倒，这就是“被禁止”的感觉！

translation: phrase. 能说两种语言的；双语的
exampleZh: 他会说英语和西班牙语，所以是双语者。
englishDefinition: To be bilingual means to be able to speak two languages fluently.
mnemonic: 必(bi)须(lingual)两种语言！想象一个人必须掌握两种语言，这就是成为双语者的必经之路！

translation: phrase. 一定会做某事；注定要做某事
exampleZh: 如果他努力学习，他一定会通过考试。
englishDefinition: If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.
mnemonic: 被(be)绑(bound)定(to)做(do)某事(sth.)!想象自己被绳子绑住，必须完成某件事，这就是'be bound to do sth.'的含义!

exampleEn: He is busy with his homework.
exampleZh: 他正忙于做作业。
englishDefinition: To be actively engaged in a task or activity, often to the exclusion of other activities.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
be angry with 对某人发脾气；生气
be busy with 忙于；从事
be busy with sth. 忙于某事
be busy doing sth. 忙于做某事

exampleEn: This book is called 'Math Basics'.
exampleZh: 这本书叫《数学基础》。
englishDefinition: To be given a particular name or title.
mnemonic: 被(be)叫(called)！想象一个场景，有人被叫去领奖，大家都在说：“被叫去领奖了！”

translation: phrase. 小心的；谨慎的；注意的
exampleZh: 小心！地板是湿的。
englishDefinition: A warning to act with caution to avoid danger or mistakes.

translation: phrase. 与…有密切关系；与…紧密相关
exampleEn: His health is closely related to his diet.
exampleZh: 他的健康与他的饮食密切相关。
englishDefinition: To have a strong connection or association with something.

translation: phrase. 由……组成；包含（通常应为 'comprise' 而非 'be comprised of'，此用法存在争议）
exampleEn: The team is comprised of five players.
exampleZh: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
englishDefinition: To be made up of or consist of certain elements or parts.
mnemonic: 被(be) 组(comprised) 成(of)!想象一个团队或集合体，由多个部分组成，这就是“由...组成”的概念!

exampleZh: 他因为生病被限制在房间里。
englishDefinition: If something is confined to a particular place, it exists only in that place. If someone is confined to a place, they are not allowed to leave that place.
mnemonic:
[联想]
confine v.限制，禁闭

translation: phrase. 与……有联系；与……有关联；连接到……
exampleEn: He is connected with the local school.
exampleZh: 他与当地学校有联系。
englishDefinition: To have a relationship or association with something.

exampleEn: He is considered as one of the best teachers in the school.
exampleZh: 他被认为是学校里最好的老师之一。
englishDefinition: To be thought of or regarded in a particular way.
mnemonic: 被(be)考虑(considered)为(as)!想象一个场景，你被大家考虑为某项任务的最佳人选，这就是你被视为专家的时刻!

exampleEn: The water can be converted into steam.
exampleZh: 水可以被转化为蒸汽。
englishDefinition: To change something into a different form or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way.
mnemonic:
[谐音]
肯为她，肯为她转变
convert：转换，变换，皈依

translation: phrase. 被判定犯有（某项罪行）
exampleEn: He was convicted of stealing a car.
exampleZh: 他因偷车被定罪。
englishDefinition: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.
mnemonic: 被(be)坑(con)的(vict)了(ed)想象一个人被完全征服了，被法庭证明有罪，这就是'被判有罪'。

translation: phrase. 与……相关联；与……有相互关系
exampleEn: The results of this study suggest that smoking is strongly correlated with lung cancer.
exampleZh: 这项研究的结论表明，吸烟与肺癌有很强的相关性。
englishDefinition: To have a mutual relationship or connection, in which one thing affects or depends on another.

translation: phrase. 对…有害的；对…造成损害的
exampleZh: 过量饮酒可能对健康有害。
englishDefinition: If something is detrimental to something else, it causes harm or damage to it.
mnemonic: 对...有害的(be detrimental to)!想象一个医生对病人说:“这对你的健康有害!”这就是“对...有害”的含义。

exampleZh: 这本书和我上周读的那本不一样。
englishDefinition: To be unlike something else in nature, form, or quality.

translation: phrase. 非常便宜的；廉价得惊人
exampleEn: This phone is dirt-cheap at the market.
exampleZh: 这手机在市场上便宜得要命。
englishDefinition: extremely inexpensive
mnemonic: 脏(dirt)便宜(cheap)!想象一下，泥土(dirt)的价格，那肯定是极其便宜(cheap)的!

translation: phrase. 被……分散注意力的；因……而分心的
exampleZh: 他被巨大的噪音分散了注意力。
englishDefinition: To have one's attention drawn away from something by something else.
mnemonic: 被(be)分心(distracted)了!想象一个人正在看书，突然被窗外的鸟叫声吸引，这就是“被分心”了!

exampleEn: The class is divided into two groups.
exampleZh: 这个班级被分成两个小组。
englishDefinition: To be separated into parts or sections.
mnemonic:
[辨析]
be divided on 在…方面存在分歧

exampleEn: I'm done with this project.
exampleZh: 我已经完成了这个项目。
englishDefinition: To finish or complete something, especially something that has been ongoing or troublesome.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
考研：不再操心；完成；结束
be / have done with

translation: phrase. 由某人决定；取决于某人；责任在某人
exampleEn: It's down to you to decide what to do next.
exampleZh: 下一步该怎么做由你来决定。
englishDefinition: If something is down to a particular person, they are responsible for it or have the right to make decisions about it.

translation: phrase. 非常渴望做某事；迫不及待想做某事
exampleEn: He is dying to play soccer after school.
exampleZh: 他放学后急着去踢足球。
englishDefinition: To have a very strong desire or eagerness to do something.
mnemonic: 别(bie)死(si)想(xiang)做(zuo)某事(moushi)!想象一个人非常渴望做某事，以至于说“别死想做某事!”来表达他们的强烈愿望。

translation: phrase. 被嵌入；被嵌入其中；被牢固地置于
exampleEn: The truth is embedded in the story.
exampleZh: 真相隐藏在这个故事中。
englishDefinition: To be fixed firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass; to be an integral part of.
mnemonic: 被(be)嵌入(embedded)在(in)...中!想象一个芯片被嵌入到卡片中，牢牢地固定在那里，这就是“被嵌入到...中”的场景!

exampleEn: She remained faithful to her principles throughout her life.
exampleZh: 她一生都忠于自己的原则。
englishDefinition: To remain loyal or constant to someone or something.
mnemonic:
[其他]
faith n信仰；信念；信任；忠实
faithfully adv忠实地；诚心诚意地；深信着地
faithfulness n忠诚；诚实；正确
faithless a不忠实的；无信的；无宗教信仰的
faithlessly adv靠不住地；不忠实地
faithlessness n不贞；无信仰；不可信赖
faithful / loyal的区别：
faithful对人对事或者对诺言誓言的始终不渝，侧重任何情况下都绝不改变
loyal对祖国、领袖的忠诚或对事业原则誓言的忠实

translation: phrase. 以……而闻名；作为……出名
exampleEn: He is famous as a singer.
exampleZh: 他以歌手的身份而出名。
englishDefinition: To be well known for a particular quality or skill.
mnemonic: 被(be)发(fa)明(mous)啊(as)!想象一个人因为发明了某个东西而闻名，大家都说:“被发明的啊!”这就是他“以...而闻名”的原因!

translation: phrasal verb. 被……淹没；收到大量……
exampleEn: The school is flooded with applications this year.
exampleZh: 今年学校收到了大量的申请。
englishDefinition: To be filled or overwhelmed with a large quantity of something.
mnemonic: 被(be)洪水(flood)淹没(with)!想象一个场景，你的邮箱被洪水般的邮件淹没，这就是'be flooded with'的意思，表示被大量的某物充满或淹没。

translation: phrase. 不受……影响的；摆脱了……的；无……的
exampleEn: He wants to be free of worries.
exampleZh: 他想摆脱烦恼。
englishDefinition: To be without something that is unwanted or unpleasant.
mnemonic: 被(be)自由(free)的(of)!想象一个人从束缚中解放出来，大声宣布：“我被自由的!”这就是他摆脱了所有的束缚!

exampleEn: He is from Canada.
exampleZh: 他来自加拿大。
englishDefinition: To originate or hail from a particular place.
mnemonic: 是(be)来自(from)!想象一个人站在国旗下，自豪地说:“我是来自这里的!”这就是他的“来源”!

translation: phrase. 被设计成适合…的；针对…而调整的
exampleEn: This course is geared to beginners.
exampleZh: 这门课程面向初学者。
englishDefinition: To be designed or adjusted to meet a particular requirement or to suit a particular group.
mnemonic: 逼(be)急(geared)了(to)!想象一下，你的工作或生活被逼急了，必须适应新的环境或要求，这就是“适应于，适合于”的真实写照!

translation: phrase. 被突然打击；被迫面对（问题、费用等）
exampleEn: He was hit with a sudden pain.
exampleZh: 他突然感到一阵疼痛。
englishDefinition: To be affected by something, often something unpleasant or unexpected.

translation: 短语动词. 对某人来说是家；让某人感到安心或自在的地方
exampleZh: 这个公园是许多鸟的家园。
englishDefinition: To be the place where someone lives or belongs.

translation: phrase. 与…完全相同；与…一模一样
exampleEn: This key is identical to the one I lost.
exampleZh: 这把钥匙和我丢的那把一模一样。
englishDefinition: To be exactly the same as something else.
mnemonic: be(是) identical(完全相同的) to(到)!想象你在比较两件物品，发现它们完全一样，就可以说'be identical to'。这就是'与...完全相同'的意思!

exampleEn: He is ignorant of the rules.
exampleZh: 他不知道这些规则。
englishDefinition: If you are ignorant of something, you do not know about it.
mnemonic:
[串记]
ignorant adj.无知的
ignorantly adv.无知地；不学无术地
ignorance n.无知，愚昧；不知，不懂
ignoramus n.不学无术的人；无知的人
ignorant, innocent ignorant是 “不知道的， 无知的”的意思
innocent是“天真的， 思想简单的”的意思

translation: phrase. 对……印象深刻；感到钦佩
exampleZh: 我对她的数学能力印象深刻。
englishDefinition: To feel admiration or respect for someone or something because of their abilities, qualities, or achievements.
mnemonic: 被(be)印(im)象(press)了(with)!想象你被一幅画深深吸引，那就是你对它“印象深刻”!

translation: phrase. 控制；掌管；对……有控制力
exampleEn: He is in control of the machine.
exampleZh: 他掌控着这台机器。
englishDefinition: To have the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.
mnemonic: 被(be)控制(control)的(of)!想象一个场景，你被控制在一个房间里，但你是那个掌握控制权的人，这就是“be in control of”的状态。

exampleEn: We are in need of more volunteers to help with the event.
exampleZh: 我们需要更多的志愿者来帮助这次活动。
englishDefinition: To require something because it is essential or very important.
mnemonic: 必(be)需(in)要(need)的(of)!想象你在一个荒岛上，指着必需品说:“必需的物品都在这里!”这就是你“需要”的东西!

translation: 短语动词. 正当令的；正当时节的（指水果、蔬菜等在自然成熟的季节中，供应充足且价格较低）
exampleEn: Strawberries are in season now, so they are cheaper.
exampleZh: v. 草莓现在正当时令，所以更便宜。
englishDefinition: If a food is in season, it is the time of year when it is naturally available and ready to eat.
mnemonic: 当季(be in season)的水果和蔬菜不仅新鲜，而且价格更实惠。记住“be in season”就像在说“现在是它的季节”!

translation: phrase. 有……的习惯；经常做某事
exampleEn: He is in the habit of drinking coffee every morning.
exampleZh: 他有每天早上喝咖啡的习惯。
englishDefinition: To have a tendency or custom to do something regularly.

exampleEn: Please move your bike; it's in the way.
exampleZh: 请把你的自行车挪开；它挡路了。
englishDefinition: To be in a position that blocks someone or something; to prevent someone from doing something or something from happening by being in a particular place or condition.

translation: phrase. 徒劳的；白费的；没有结果的
exampleEn: He tried to fix the car, but it was in vain.
exampleZh: 他试图修理汽车，但徒劳无功。
englishDefinition: Without success or result; futile.

translation: phrase. 与…不相容的；与……对立
exampleEn: This software may be incompatible with older operating systems.
exampleZh: 这个软件可能与旧的操作系统不兼容。
englishDefinition: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they do not suit each other or agree with each other.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
compatible adj.兼容的，可和谐共存的
incompatible adj.不兼容，不相配，不调和的

exampleEn: The weather is independent of my plans.
exampleZh: 天气与我的计划无关。
englishDefinition: To not be influenced or controlled by something or someone.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
=be independent from
不依赖的；不受支配的

exampleEn: He is likely to fail the test.
exampleZh: 他很可能考不及格。
englishDefinition: To have a high probability of doing something.
mnemonic:
[语法]
be likely to do
it's likely that
但probable只能用于 it is probable that 句型中 ，没有be probable to 的说法

translation: phrase. 迷路的；迷失的；不知所措的
exampleEn: He was lost in the woods.
exampleZh: 他在森林中迷路了。
englishDefinition: To be unable to find one's way or to be confused about what to do or say.
mnemonic: 被(be) 老(lost)式地图迷路了!想象你拿着一份老式地图，却怎么也找不到正确的路，这就是“迷失”的感觉!

exampleEn: He is loyal to his friends.
exampleZh: 他对朋友忠诚。
englishDefinition: To be faithful and committed to someone or something.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
be loyal to=be true to=be faithful to对....忠诚

exampleEn: He is mad at his brother for breaking his toy.
exampleZh: 他因为弟弟弄坏了玩具而生他的气。
englishDefinition: To feel or show anger towards someone.
mnemonic:
[辨析]
be mad at 对…愤怒
be mad about 迷恋；对…狂热
be fascinated by 着迷于…
be stuck on 迷恋上…；贴在…上

exampleEn: Paper is made from wood.
exampleZh: 纸是由木头制成的。
englishDefinition: To be produced or created from a particular material or substance.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
be made of+原料 由……制成（能看出原料）
be made from+原料 由……制成（不能看出原料）
be made by sb. 被某人制造，强调制作人
be made in sp. 在……地方制造，强调产地
原料+be made into+成品 ……被做成……

translation: phrase. 注意到；留意；意识到（某事）
exampleZh: 离开家时要留意时间。
englishDefinition: To be mindful of something means to be aware of it and give it your attention.
mnemonic: 别(bie) 忙(mang) 得(de) 忘(wang) 了(le) 留(liu) 意(yi) 哦(o)! 想象你在忙碌的日常生活中，提醒自己别忘了留意周围的事物，这就是‘be mindful of’的含义。

translation: phrase. 对……感到紧张的；对……感到焦虑的
exampleZh: 他对于数学考试感到紧张。
englishDefinition: To feel anxious or worried about something that is going to happen or might happen.
mnemonic: 别(be) 那(nervous) 关于(about)! 想象一个人对即将发生的事情感到紧张，心里想着“别那关于的事情让我紧张！”这就是他的“对...感到紧张”状态！

translation: phrase. 有义务的；不得不；必须（做某事）
exampleZh: 我必须在晚饭前完成作业。
englishDefinition: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because it is a law, a rule, or a duty.
mnemonic: 被(be)迫(oblige)做(to)!想象你被逼着去做某件事，这就是'不得不'的感觉!

translation: 短语动词. 正在节食；在控制饮食以减肥
exampleEn: He is on a diet to lose weight.
exampleZh: 他正在节食以减重。
englishDefinition: To follow a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.
mnemonic: be (是) on (在) a (一个) diet (节食)! 想象你站在一个巨大的食物秤上，说“我是在节食!”这就是你的“节食”计划!

translation: phrase. 处于借用状态；被借出；在租借期间
exampleEn: The book is on loan to my friend.
exampleZh: 这本书借给了我的朋友。
englishDefinition: To be temporarily given to someone else for use, especially in the context of books, artworks, or employees.
mnemonic: 被(be)借(on loan)走了!想象一本书被借走，就像它去了一次短暂的旅行，最终会回到原来的位置。

translation: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
exampleEn: After the factory closed, he was out of work for several months.
exampleZh: 工厂关闭后，他失业了好几个月。
englishDefinition: To be without a job; unemployed.
mnemonic: 别(bé)无(wú)工(gōng)作(zuò)!想象一个人站在空荡荡的办公室里，四处张望，说:“别无工作可做!”这就是他的“失业”状态!

exampleEn: He is particular about his coffee always being hot.
exampleZh: 他对咖啡总是要热的很讲究。
englishDefinition: To be very careful or concerned about something, especially in a way that is considered excessive or unnecessary.
mnemonic: 别(be) 挑剔(particular) 啊(about)! 想象一个人对每件事都非常讲究，总是在说：“别挑剔啊！”

translation: phrase. 永久性受损的；无法修复的
exampleEn: The painting was permanently damaged by the flood.
exampleZh: 这幅画因洪水而永久损坏。
englishDefinition: To be in a state of irreversible harm or destruction.
mnemonic: 被(be)永久(permanently)损坏(damaged)!想象一个物品被永久损坏，无法修复，这就是“be permanently damaged”的含义!

translation: phrase. 精通于……的；在……方面熟练的
exampleZh: 他擅长数学。
englishDefinition: To have or show a high level of skill or ability in a particular activity or subject.

translation: phrasal verb. 被推迟；被劝阻；感到反感
exampleZh: 他被那股难闻的气味吓退了。
englishDefinition: To be deterred or discouraged from doing something.

translation: phrase. 抵抗…的；对…有抵抗力的
exampleEn: The new material is resistant to high temperatures.
exampleZh: 这种新材料对高温有抵抗力。
englishDefinition: To be able to withstand or oppose something, such as a force, influence, or condition.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
resist doing 抵抗，抵挡
resistant adj.抵抗的，顽固的
resistance n.阻力，抵抗

insistence n.坚持，强调
insist v. 坚持，主张
insist on doing sth. 坚持做某事

translation: verb phrase. 充满…的；饱含…的；被…浸透的
exampleEn: The paper is saturated with too many details.
exampleZh: 这篇论文充满了太多细节。
englishDefinition: To be filled with something so that no more can be added; to be thoroughly soaked or imbued with a substance or quality.
mnemonic: 被(be)沙(sa)特(tu)拉(ra)特(ted)喂(with)!想象一个沙漠被水饱和，沙子变成了泥浆，人们说:“被沙特拉特喂!”这就是“饱和”的状态!

translation: phrase. 是……的缩写；是……的简称

exampleZh: ‘Bob’是‘Robert’的缩写。
englishDefinition: If something is short for a particular word or name, it is a shorter way of saying or writing it.

translation: phrase. 在某方面擅长；熟练
exampleEn: She is highly skilled in computer programming.
exampleZh: 她精通计算机编程。
englishDefinition: If you are skilled in something, you have the ability and knowledge to do it well.
mnemonic:

be accomplished in

be expert in
be at home in
verse in; be versed in
be good/adept at

have a grasp/grip on

translation: 短语动词. 对...要求严格；对...认真对待
exampleEn: My mom is strict about homework.
exampleZh: 我妈妈对作业要求很严格。
englishDefinition: To be very careful and precise in following rules or standards, and to demand that others do the same.

translation: phrase. 充满，洋溢（常用于情感或光线等抽象事物）
exampleEn: The room was suffused with sunlight.
exampleZh: 房间里充满了阳光。
englishDefinition: If something such as a book, film, or piece of music is suffused with a particular quality, that quality spreads all through it and is very noticeable in it.
mnemonic: 被(be) 色(suf) 覆(fuse) 的(ed) 与(with)!想象一幅画，被色彩从内到外地覆盖，这就是'被色彩覆盖'的感觉!

translation: phrase. v. 对……有把握；确信……
exampleEn: I am not sure about the answer.
exampleZh: 我不确定这个答案。
englishDefinition: To be certain or confident about something.

exampleEn: The house is surrounded by tall trees.
exampleZh: 这所房子被高大的树木环绕着。
englishDefinition: To be all around someone or something, so that they are enclosed or confined.
mnemonic: 被(be)环绕(surround)着(by)!想象一幅画面，你站在一片被美丽花园环绕的草地上，这就是“被...包围”的感觉。

translation: phrase. 被……淹没；应接不暇地处理某事，通常指被大量工作或事务压得喘不过气
exampleEn: He is swamped with homework every night.
exampleZh: 他每天晚上都被作业压得喘不过气。
englishDefinition: If you are swamped with things such as work, you have more of them than you can deal with.
mnemonic: 被(be)淹(swamp)了(with)!想象你正站在一个沼泽地里，突然水涨船高，你被水淹没了，这就是“被淹没”的感觉。

translation: phrase. 被迷住的；对…产生好感的；喜欢上…的
exampleEn: He is taken with the new teacher.
exampleZh: 他被这位新老师吸引了。
englishDefinition: If you are taken with someone or something, you are very interested in them or attracted to them.
mnemonic: 被(be)带(taken)着(with)走!想象一个人被某种魅力或想法带着走，完全被吸引，这就是“对...感兴趣；被...吸引”的感觉!

translation: phrase. 对某人心存感激；感谢某人
exampleZh: 我感谢我的老师帮助我。
englishDefinition: To express gratitude to someone for something they have done or given.
mnemonic: 感(gan)谢(xie)的(de)心(xin)态(tai)!想象自己在对帮助过你的人说:“感谢的心态让我更加珍惜每一份帮助!”

exampleEn: My shirt and your shirt be the same.
exampleZh: 我的衬衫和你的衬衫是一样的。
englishDefinition: To be identical or equivalent in nature, value, or appearance.

translation: phrase. 忙于工作而脱不开身；被工作占用无法分身
exampleEn: I can't make it to the meeting because I'm tied up at work.
exampleZh: 我不能参加会议，因为工作缠身。
englishDefinition: To be extremely busy or occupied with work, leaving no free time.

translation: phrasal verb. 忙于……；被……缠住；与……有密切关联
exampleEn: He is tied up with work today.
exampleZh: 他今天忙于工作。
englishDefinition: To be closely involved with something or busy with something.
mnemonic: 被(be)绑(tied)上(up)了(with)! 想象一个人被各种任务和项目绑得紧紧的，这就是他忙碌的“被绑定”状态!

translation: phrase. 悬而未决的；不确定的
exampleEn: The trip plans are still up in the air.
exampleZh: 旅行计划仍然未定。
englishDefinition: If something is up in the air, it is uncertain and often because it has not been decided or agreed on.
mnemonic: 想象一个气球飘在空中，事情就像气球一样，还未落地，即‘悬而未决’。这就是‘be up in the air’的意思！

exampleEn: He is used to waking up early.
exampleZh: 他习惯早起。
englishDefinition: If you are used to something, you are familiar with it because you have done it or experienced it many times before.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
sb. be used to doing sth. 某人习惯于做某事
sth. be used to do sth. 某物被用于做某事
sb. used to do sth. 某人过去常常做某事

translation: 用于做某事，表示某物被用来做某事，通常指用途或功能
exampleEn: This tool is used to cut wood.
exampleZh: 这个工具被用来切割木头。
englishDefinition: To have a particular function or purpose; to be employed for a specific task.

exampleEn: Water is vital to all living things.
exampleZh: 水对所有生物都至关重要。
englishDefinition: To be extremely important or necessary for the success, existence, or health of something or someone.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
vital至关重要的，生死攸关的，充满活力的
vital已含有most important的意思,故不再用于比较级和最高级。

这组词都可表示“重要的”。significant指某事特别有意义,尤其突出、为人所记忆或长远看很有贡献,但不一定有紧迫的或强有力的含意; important既可指某事意味深长,也可指有一点价值的; vital指对整体的安宁或成功能起到重大的、不可缺少的作用。

translation: phrase. 人员配备充足的；拥有足够员工的
exampleEn: The hospital is well-staffed.
exampleZh: 这家医院人员配备充足。
englishDefinition: Having an adequate number of qualified employees to meet operational needs.

translation: phrasal verb. 全神贯注于；被深深吸引；被包裹着
exampleEn: He is wrapped up in his book.
exampleZh: 他全神贯注地看书。
englishDefinition: To be completely engrossed or absorbed in an activity or subject.

translation: n. 梁；桁；“beam”的复数； v. 发射电波；“beam”的复数
exampleEn: The bridge is supported by strong steel beams.
exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的钢梁支撑。
englishDefinition: 1. A beam is a line of light that shines from a bright object. 2. A beam is a long thick bar of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof or floor of a building. 3. If you beam, you smile broadly.
mnemonic:

be-是
am-按摩

梁是用来去按摩蛇的

englishDefinition: A bean-sprout is a sprout from a bean, typically used as a vegetable in cooking.

sprout 发芽
bean-sprout 发芽的豆子，豆芽

exampleEn: He wears a beanie in winter.
exampleZh: 他冬天戴一顶毛线帽。
englishDefinition: A beanie is a small, round, close-fitting hat, usually made of wool, that is worn on the head to keep it warm.
mnemonic: 比(be)安(an)妮(ie)!想象一个叫安妮的女孩，戴着一顶比安帽，在寒冷的天气里保持温暖。这就是她的“比安妮”帽!

translation: phrase. 结出果实；产生结果；奏效
exampleEn: If you work hard, your efforts will bear fruit.
exampleZh: 如果你努力工作，你的努力会结出果实。
englishDefinition: To produce a desired result or to become successful.
mnemonic: 想象一只熊（bear）在果园里，它努力地摇晃果树，终于果实（fruit）纷纷落下，象征着努力终将得到回报。

translation: phrase. 和…有关；对...施加压力；瞄准
exampleEn: This new fact does not bear on the case.

englishDefinition: To be relevant or important to; to have an effect on.

englishDefinition: To bear up means to endure or withstand something difficult or painful without giving in or collapsing.

exampleEn: Please bear with me while I fix the computer.

englishDefinition: To be patient and wait while someone does something.

忍受

englishDefinition: Having a beard.

beard n.胡须

englishDefinition: A beast is a large and dangerous animal, or a cruel and brutal person.

englishDefinition: To beat someone up means to hit them repeatedly, especially in a violent way.
mnemonic: 比(bi)特(te)阿(a)普(pu)!想象一个拳击手在擂台上，对着对手说:“比特阿普!”然后连续出拳，这就是他的“痛打”战术!

translation: v. 深深打动；（使）着迷；（使）眼花缭乱；迷惑

englishDefinition: Prior to the deadlines; in advance of the set time limits.

englishDefinition: The early stages or initial parts of something.

exampleEn: His hands were begrimed with dirt from working in the garden.
exampleZh: 他在花园里干活，双手沾满了污垢。
englishDefinition: To make something dirty, especially with soot or dirt.
mnemonic: 被(be)裹(grime)!想象一个被灰尘和污垢裹住的物品，这就是“弄脏”了!

exampleEn: The teacher asked the children to behave themselves during the trip.
exampleZh: 老师要求孩子们在旅行期间要守规矩。
englishDefinition: To conduct oneself in a specified way, especially in a way that is socially acceptable.

[扩展]
behave（举止） oneself（个人的）——个人的举止
固定搭配。 意为“让某人管好自己，规规矩矩的”

translation: phrase. 以自私的方式行事；表现得自私

englishDefinition: To act in a way that prioritizes one's own advantage without regard for others.

exampleEn: He behaves kindly to everyone.
exampleZh: 他对每个人都表现得很友善。
englishDefinition: To act or conduct oneself in a specified way, especially towards others.

behaviorism

exampleEn: The bus stop is behind the station.

exampleEn: The beholder saw the beautiful sunset.

englishDefinition: A beholder is someone who sees or looks at something.

spectator=onlooker. 吃瓜群众/观众/旁观者
speculator. 形似spectator.
pedestrian. 路人

translation: n. 人；生物；生物（ being的名词复数 ）
exampleEn: All human beings want to be happy.
exampleZh: 所有人类都希望快乐。
englishDefinition: Plural of being: a living creature; existence or reality.

exampleEn: His beliefs guide his daily choices.

exampleEn: This book belonged to my grandfather.

below 在下面，line意思为线条，在线下面---线下

exampleEn: Ben is my friend's name.

translation: n. 苯那君（药品苯海拉明（diphenhydramine）的一种品牌，伤风抗素剂的一种）

translation: phrase. 有益的效果；有利的影响
exampleEn: Eating vegetables has a beneficial effect on health.

exampleEn: The bronchus carries air to the lungs.
exampleZh: 支气管将空气输送到肺部。
englishDefinition: A bronchus is a passage of airway in the respiratory system that conducts air into the lungs.

bronch分支（branch） us我们
我们都有的分支---支气管

exampleEn: He lives in Brooklyn with his family.
exampleZh: 他和家人住在布鲁克林。
englishDefinition: A borough of New York City, located on the western end of Long Island, known for its diverse neighborhoods.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
布鲁克林，美国一个街区。

exampleEn: My bros and I play basketball after school.
exampleZh: 我和我的兄弟们放学后打篮球。
englishDefinition: A term used to refer to male friends or brothers, often in a casual or affectionate manner.
mnemonic: bro(bro) + s(s)! 想象你和你的兄弟们在一起，互相称呼“bro”，这就是你们的兄弟情谊!

exampleEn: My brothers play soccer every weekend.
exampleZh: 我的兄弟们每个周末都踢足球。
englishDefinition: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.
mnemonic: 不(bu)如(ru)兄(xiong)弟(di)!想象一个场景，你和你兄弟在一起，无论做什么都不如和兄弟在一起快乐。这就是'兄弟'的力量!

exampleEn: Bruce likes to play basketball after school.
exampleZh: 布鲁斯喜欢放学后打篮球。
englishDefinition: A common male given name; also refers to Bruce Lee, the martial artist and actor, or Bruce Springsteen, the musician.
mnemonic: 布鲁斯(bruce)！想象蝙蝠侠的本名就是布鲁斯·韦恩(Bruce Wayne)，每当你想到黑暗骑士，就记住这个酷炫的名字——bruce，英雄的代号！

translation: phrasal verb. 复习；温习；提高（技能）
exampleEn: I will brush up on my English before the exam.
exampleZh: 我将在考试前复习一下英语。
englishDefinition: To improve your knowledge of something already learned but partly forgotten.
mnemonic: 不(bu)如(ru)刷(shua)上(up)!想象你正在用刷子刷掉灰尘，就像你在复习时刷掉遗忘的知识，让它们重新变得清晰可见!

exampleEn: He wants to brush up on his math skills before the test.
exampleZh: 他想在考试前复习一下他的数学技能。
englishDefinition: To improve one's knowledge of something already learned but partly forgotten.
mnemonic:
[联想]
重新刷一刷上面的地方-温习、复习

translation: n. 小丑；滑稽可笑的人
exampleEn: He played the buffoon at the party, making everyone laugh.
exampleZh: 他在派对上扮演丑角，逗得大家哈哈大笑。
englishDefinition: A buffoon is someone who often makes people laugh by doing silly things.
mnemonic:
[联想]
联想记忆 buf(看作but) + foon(看作fool) → but a fool → 只是个笨蛋 → 愚蠢的人

exampleEn: The room has five bright bulbs.
exampleZh: 这个房间有五盏明亮的白炽灯。
englishDefinition: Bulbs are the round parts of some plants that are planted in the ground and from which new plants grow. They are also the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it.
mnemonic: 不(bu)亮(lb)死(s)!想象一个灯泡突然不亮了，你可能会说：“不亮死！”这就是灯泡的“bulbs”。

exampleEn: She has bulimia and needs help.
exampleZh: 她患有暴食症，需要帮助。
englishDefinition: Bulimia is an eating disorder characterized by regular episodes of binge eating followed by behaviors such as vomiting or excessive exercise to prevent weight gain.
mnemonic:
[词源]
U 贪食症 （亦作bulimia nervosa）

anorexia or anorexia nervosa 厌食症

exampleEn: The bulldog's tenacity is legendary.
exampleZh: 斗牛犬的顽强是出了名的。
englishDefinition: A bulldog is a breed of dog known for its muscular, heavy build and distinctive pushed-in nose. Bulldogs are commonly associated with courage and tenacity.
mnemonic: 不(bu)要(yao)斗(dou)狗(gou)! 想象一个场景，一个人对另一个人说：“不要斗狗！” 这里的“斗狗”指的是斗牛犬，强调其勇敢和顽强的特性。

exampleEn: The bumblebee is flying around the flowers.
exampleZh: 大黄蜂在花丛中飞舞。
englishDefinition: A bumblebee is a large, hairy bee which is usually black and yellow.
mnemonic:
[联想]
bumble v. 含糊不清地说话 | 笨拙地行动
bee n.蜜蜂

exampleEn: The car's bumpers were damaged in the accident.
exampleZh: 这辆车的保险杠在事故中损坏了。
englishDefinition: Bumpers are bars at the front and back of a vehicle that reduce damage if the vehicle hits something.
mnemonic: 碰碰(bump)车(er)的保险杠(bumpers)！想象一辆碰碰车在游乐场里，它的前后都有保险杠，这样即使碰撞也不会损坏车身。这就是它的'保护'作用！

translation: n. 隆起物；肿块；碰撞( bump的名词复数 )
exampleEn: The road has many bumps that make the car bounce.
exampleZh: 这条路有很多隆起物，让车颠簸。
englishDefinition: Small raised areas or lumps on a surface, or the act of hitting something with force.
mnemonic: 碰撞(bump)声(s)!想象你在开车时不小心撞到了路边的石头，发出“碰撞”声，这就是bumps的由来!

translation: phrase. 包起来；裹紧（衣物）；收拾整理
exampleEn: He bundled up before going out in the snow.
exampleZh: 他出门前穿得很暖和。
englishDefinition: To dress warmly, especially by wearing multiple layers of clothing, or to wrap something tightly in cloth or paper.
mnemonic: 绑(bundle)起来(up)!想象一个寒冷的冬天，你把自己裹得严严实实，就像把东西绑起来一样，确保温暖不流失。

translation: n. 捆；捆( bundle的名词复数 )
exampleEn: He carried bundles of firewood to the house.
exampleZh: 他提着一捆捆木柴到房子那里。
englishDefinition: A bundle is a number of things that are tied or wrapped together so that they can be carried or stored.
mnemonic: 捆(bun)得(dle)死(s)!想象一下，你捆了一堆书，结果捆得太紧，书都“死”了，这就是“捆得太死”了!

exampleEn: He loves bungee-jumping from high bridges.
exampleZh: 他喜欢从高桥上跳伞。
englishDefinition: Bungee-jumping is an activity in which a person jumps from a high place, such as a bridge or a platform, with a long elastic cord tied to their ankles, which stops them from hitting the ground.
mnemonic: 蹦(bungee)极(jump)跳(ing)!想象一个人站在高台上，绑着蹦极绳，大喊一声“蹦极跳!”然后一跃而下，这就是他的“蹦极跳”冒险!

translation: adj. 负荷的; v. 把重担加于；劳累（burden 的过去分词）
exampleEn: He was burdened with too much homework.
exampleZh: 他被太多的作业压得喘不过气。
englishDefinition: If someone is burdened with something, they are carrying a heavy load of it, often something that is difficult to bear or that causes worry.
mnemonic: 不(bu)忍(ren)得(den)!想象一个被重担压得喘不过气来的人，他可能会说:“不忍得再这样下去了!”这就是他的“负担重”的状态!

exampleEn: The burgess voted for better roads in the town.
exampleZh: 这个市议员为城镇更好的道路投了票。
englishDefinition: A burgess is a citizen or inhabitant of a borough or town, especially one who has the right to vote or participate in local government.
mnemonic:
[扩展]
burger 汉堡包
burgher 市民；公民
borough自治区
burgeon萌芽发芽；迅速成长

exampleEn: The thief burgled the house while the family was away on vacation.
exampleZh: 小偷趁这家人外出度假时破门盗窃了房子。
englishDefinition: To burgle means to enter a building illegally and steal things.
mnemonic:

translation: n. 缅甸（东南亚国家，现称Myanmar）
exampleEn: He visited Burma last summer.
exampleZh: 他去年夏天去了缅甸。
englishDefinition: Burma, officially the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, is a country in Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Bangladesh, India, China, Laos, and Thailand. Burma is known for its diverse culture, history, and natural beauty.
mnemonic: 不(bu)骂(rma)人！联想记忆：在缅甸（Burma）旅行时，要尊重当地文化，不骂人是基本礼仪。用‘不骂’谐音记住‘Burma’！

translation: v. （使）燃烧； n. 烧伤；烧伤，烧痕( burn的名词复数 ) v. （使）燃烧( burn的
exampleEn: The match burns the paper.
exampleZh: 火柴点燃了纸。
englishDefinition: If you burn something, you destroy or damage it with fire. A burn is an injury caused by fire or by something very hot.
mnemonic: 伯(b)恩(urns)! 想象一个名叫伯恩的人，他在厨房里不小心让火苗跳了起来，这就是他的“烧伤”经历!

exampleEn: The fireworks made bright bursts in the night sky.
exampleZh: 烟花在夜空中发出明亮的爆炸。
englishDefinition: 1. If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out. 2. If a place is bursting with people or things, it is full of them.
mnemonic: 爆(burst)炸了!想象一个气球突然爆炸的场景，这就是“burst”!

translation: phrase. 公交车通行证；公共汽车乘车卡
exampleEn: He uses his bus pass to ride the bus every day.
exampleZh: 他每天用他的公交卡坐公交车。
englishDefinition: A bus pass is a ticket that allows the holder to travel on buses, typically for a set period of time, such as a month or a year.
mnemonic: 不(bu)用(s)怕(pass)!想象一下，有了公交车通行证，你就不用怕错过公交车了，因为它能让你随时随地乘坐。

exampleEn: They bushwalk in the national park every weekend.
exampleZh: 他们每周末在国家公园里徒步穿越灌木丛。
englishDefinition: A bushwalk is a walk through the bush, or countryside, especially in Australia, for pleasure or exercise.
mnemonic: 布(bu)什(sh)沃(walk)!想象在茂密的丛林中，每一步都踏在未知的路径上，这就是“丛林徒步旅行”的冒险之旅!

exampleEn: She is the busiest person in the office.
exampleZh: 她是办公室里最忙的人。
englishDefinition: Superlative form of busy: most busy.
mnemonic: 最(busy)的!想象在办公室，大家都在忙碌，但有一个人是最忙的，那就是“最忙的”!

translation: phrase. 企业管理；经营管理；工商管理
exampleEn: He is studying business administration at university.
exampleZh: 他正在大学学习工商管理。
englishDefinition: Business administration is the study of how to manage and supervise the operation of a business or organization.

exampleEn: He regularly meets with his business associates to discuss new projects.

englishDefinition: A business associate is a person or company that you have a business relationship with, especially one that you work with on a particular project or activity.
mnemonic: 比(bi)赛(si)呢(ni)思(si)啊(a)索(so)西(xi)艾(ai)特(te)!想象在商业竞赛中，你与你的商业伙伴一起思考策略，说:“比赛呢，思啊索西艾特!”这就是你们的合作精神!

translation: phrase. 商业模式；经营模式
exampleEn: The company changed its business model to sell online.

englishDefinition: A business model describes the rationale of how an organization creates, delivers, and captures value.

exampleEn: He is a busybody who asks too many questions.

exampleEn: They traveled by boat to the island.
exampleZh: 他们乘船去的岛。
englishDefinition: Using a boat as a means of transportation.
mnemonic: 乘(b)船(boat)!想象一下，你正乘着船在海上航行，享受海风拂面的感觉，这就是“乘船”旅行。

translation: phrase. 用现金；以现金方式

mnemonic: 用(yong)现(xian)金(jin)！想象在市场上，你拿出钱包，用现金支付，这就是‘by cash’的方式。

exampleEn: She became more confident by degrees.

exampleEn: I will finish my homework by friday.
exampleZh: 我将在星期五之前完成作业。
englishDefinition: Before or on the day of Friday.

exampleEn: His English is improving by leaps and bounds.
exampleZh: 他的英语正在飞速进步。
englishDefinition: If something increases or improves by leaps and bounds, it does so very quickly and to a great extent.
mnemonic: 想象一只兔子在田野里跳跃，每次跳跃都向前迈进一大步，这就是“by leaps and bounds”的助记形象。

exampleEn: He has finished his homework by now.

englishDefinition: Up to the present moment; at this time.

exampleEn: They went to Paris by plane.

englishDefinition: By plane means to travel using an aircraft as the means of transportation.

by air = by plane 乘飞机，搭飞机。take a plane 乘飞机

treaty 条约
